content.summary: An adult violinist is verified across face, seated tuning and standing views. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: At least three identity anchors remain stable. + Every detail view reconnects to a complete body. + Pose changes do not alter age or anatomy. + Wardrobe remains one coherent set. + The final full view verifies the opening identity.
quick_start.recommended_input: Lock one original adult animated violinist with copper curls, green eyes and a square silver ear cuff in a pale-blue studio. Widen to her seated tuning pose, preserving the navy coat and amber violin. End on the same violinist standing with violin lowered and all identity anchors readable.
required_anchors: At least three identity anchors remain stable.
Every detail view reconnects to a complete body.
The final full view verifies the opening identity.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: An adult violinist is verified across face, seated tuning and standing views. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
